title: Interval Taken Off a Vehicle that Has Needed Recovery
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing that has had to be recovered has interval taken off the next grant, and what is counted is the completed Keyturn Roadside Assistance callouts standing on the vehicle in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date.

1. A vehicle with two or more completed Keyturn Roadside Assistance callouts in that window has 1500 miles taken off.

2. A vehicle with exactly one completed callout in that window has 500 miles taken off.

3. A vehicle with no completed callout in that window has nothing taken off on this ground, a reduction of 0 miles.

### Points of judgement

*Completed callouts only.* A callout standing on the vehicle that was not completed is not counted.

*Where the count divides.* At 2 completed callouts the first clause governs; at exactly 1 the second; at none the third. A vehicle with 4 completed callouts in the window is still on the first clause, which turns on two or more rather than on how many.

*The window.* The rolling twenty-four months are counted back from the handling date, so a callout dated twenty-five months back is not counted.
